---
name: New note kind
about: Propose a new typed fact for Hirelog to remember
labels: new-kind
---

**Kind name** (snake_case)

**Subject** (company / ats / posting)

**The fact it captures** - what do agents learn that no existing kind holds? Why not `tip`?

**Payload fields** (name, type, allowed values, required?)

**Evidence** - which evidence types usually back it?

**Half-life** - how fast does this fact go stale, and why?

**Dedupe signature** - which fields make two notes "the same fact"?

**Example notes** (2-3, fictional or fully anonymised, no people)

**Privacy check** - it describes employer or hiring-system behaviour, not a person.
